text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I find Mejiro Bright standing at the school entrance with a smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer, today's a special day off at Tracen Academy. No lessons nor training sessions will be held.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: So, if you would please enter the car behind you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The door to a large black sedan parked parallel to the academy gates opens. The driver dressed in black politely bows.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Teehee! You should already know. Our destination is your second home, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: We're going to the Mejiro estate, of course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't shake the feeling that this isn't really happening. At the center of the scene stands the grandmother of the family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's surrounded by the other notable Mejiros. I can tell from the tension in the air that a heavy discussion is imminent.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: If it is amenable to all, I, Mejiro Ardan, will lead today's proceedings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Our topic of discussion is the new wave that has struck the Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: In other words, the "speed above all" mindset that continues to spread.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The presentation, please.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Butler
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Those attention-grabbing words "speed above all" appear on the screen alongside a video.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Until very recently, both speed and stamina were considered equal components in the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: However, as of late, the idea that speed is more important has been gaining traction.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Many Umamusume emphasize this in their training, while the duration of races has been shortening. Additionally…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: More and more are refraining from participating in stately long-distance races such as the Kikuka Sho and spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: We're in an age of unprecedented speed. The Umamusume garnering the most attention at this time…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Is Marvelous Sunday, with Special Week and others not far behind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: These Umamusume are racing at speeds that challenge the common notion of what is possible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I am certain we will see more of this spectacular ability emerge among the Umamusume who seize victory in the G1 Classics.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It is safe to conclude that these racers are the fastest history has yet to produce.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Until now, this time of year saw the racing world abuzz with speculation over who would win the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: However, the times have changed. Now, the greater emphasis is on medium-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Our main concern for today is reflecting on this change and how we can best react to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Goodness, Trainer. This took quite a turn.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Here I am, bearing witness to the great Mejiro family determining their approach to contending with this new era of speed-first racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Grandmother
text_block_list.text: From well-built, rounded athleticism… to speed. This change has been happening gradually for some time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Grandmother
text_block_list.text: Yet, the final catalyst to bring us fully to this new age was the appearance of a certain racer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Grandmother
text_block_list.text: The video, please.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Butler
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Grandmother
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki. Her speed is nearly magical. With it, she earned shining recognition as a junior champion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Grandmother
text_block_list.text: Those of the racing world were awestruck by her speed, and that hastened the arrival of today's preference.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Grandmother
text_block_list.text: We cannot change the general consensus surrounding racing today. Our concern is rather how the Mejiros should respond.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Grandmother
text_block_list.text: Our plan has always been to foster Umamusume capable of winning the spring Tenno Sho and other exemplary long-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Grandmother
text_block_list.text: However, considering the limited time each of you have for study and training, I am beginning to think our methods outdated.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Grandmother
text_block_list.text: I believe we have time for an open discussion. Hence, I want you all to share your unfiltered thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Grandmother
text_block_list.text: I also expect each one of you to reflect on what you wish the Mejiro family to be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With those words, Grandmother Mejiro leaves the room.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Grandmother's right that this is something we need to think about, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Does it really need so much attention? We've all got our different goals and training routines…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But, like, think about it. What are you gonna do if everyone else just whooshes past you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Precisely. However, I hesitate to think changing the Mejiro way is the best course of action.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It seems the easy route, but it risks us forgetting our history. We should bear that in mind as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Then, doesn't that make Ryan right? We can just keep on like nothing's changed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: We might have to deal with fans losing interest in us if we seem out of the times, though…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: We would only have that privilege if we continue to win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: No matter how you see it, the culture around racing is ever-changing. That includes the organization of the races themselves.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: We may win all the long-distance races, but if we cannot hold our own in medium-distances and the balance of our record begins to change…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Our influence, then, will begin to fade. People will begin to think the Mejiros lost their force.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: If we are to prevent that, we may be left with no other choice…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So we should ride the wave? Double down on speed training?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I understand your point, but I can't go along with that. Of course, I know speed is important, but to throw away what makes us Mejiro…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Opinions fly back and forth, and strong arguments are made, yet no one can agree.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the midst of this debate, Mejiro McQueen's eyes meet mine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you have any thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: We'd appreciate the perspective of an outsider. Please, what do you think the Mejiros should do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm suddenly brought into the conversation. Something feels caught in my throat, but I know I can't refuse her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright gives me a gentle, reassuring smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She herself is included in all this, as an inheritor and emblem of the Mejiro tradition. If I consider the road she's taken thus far as the path she should continue to follow…
choice_data_list: I think… you can win everything as you all are.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Win everything as we are? You're saying we can beat speed by continuing to focus on stamina?
choice_data_list: Yeah. That's the Mejiro way, if you ask me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That was certainly true in the past, I say further. Mejiro Umamusume dominated both medium and long-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think it'd be best for them to improve on the formula they've used this whole time. It's what Mejiro Bright has been doing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Gotcha. Should've expected Bright's trainer to say something like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You've got guts! A setback like this is like a fun challenge to you, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Words are just words. Actions are what matter. I trust you understand that, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Accomplishing what you've said means winning the spring Tenno Sho…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And it means she must stand as a bulwark against this age of incredible speed. Do you understand?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Goose bumps rise on my arms. When put like that, it sounds pretty difficult…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: But, McQueen, together with Trainer, I will do it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let us make our attempt.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: We will win the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: By securing victory there, I will have stood against the trend and protected the Mejiro family in the process.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The thought of my beloved Mejiro family wavering against this wave makes my heart ache.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer and I will do what we must to protect the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer, can I trust you to stand with me? With us together, I believe there's no need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You and I met for this exact reason, as part of this long history.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I understand. I will report to Grandmother with our decision. The Mejiros will emerge victorious without changing our ways.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Heheh. I now see the value of inviting guests to the estate every once in a while. Bright's trainer helped to move things along.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thus, Mejiro Bright has made her sudden promise to win the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Mejiros cannot be left behind. They must defeat this new generation of runners who value speed over all else.
